purpose: Add a conservative deployment gate after the M2.79 multi-family stitch selector so risky stitch-family promotions require a stronger score margin over reject.

selected_policy.rule: If the selector predicts a risky stitch family but its score margin over reject is below 0.20, deploy reject instead.

interpretation: M2.80 is a conservative professional safety layer. It removes all held-out false texture promotions and improves reject recall, while sacrificing a small amount of non-base positive recall. It is not yet a new DST output profile; it is the deployment gate to use before allowing M2.79-style family predictions to control actual DST generation.
